package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteCourseI18n removes localization for a course.
type DeleteCourseI18n struct {
	CourseI18n repository.CourseI18nRepository
}

// Handle deletes localization entry.
func (uc DeleteCourseI18n) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string, i18nID int) error {
	if courseID == "" || i18nID <= 0 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.CourseI18n.DeleteByCourse(ctx, courseID, i18nID)
}
